highlight.description: Second, colored half of the heading.

cta_label.description: Optional button shown inside the card (overlay layout).

footer_logo.description: Optional small logo shown below the card (columns layout).

attribution.description: Gold attribution line for centered and attributed variants (e.g. "- President Name").

date.description: Centered variant meta / event variant date card value (e.g. "Nov 28, 2025").

category.description: Centered variant meta shown after the date; event variant event-card value (e.g. "Convocation").

event_label.description: Event variant: label above the category value in the meta card (defaults to "Event").

date_label.description: Event variant: label above the date value in the meta card (defaults to "Date").

portrait.description: Portrait image for the attributed variant.

pill_image.description: Event variant: photo shown inside the decorative pill shape on the right.

bg_pattern.description: Alternative background image field (same effect as Background image).

title.description: Optional section title. When set, the row renders as a page section with side padding.

items.description: Row items. Each becomes a column on desktop and stacks on mobile.

width.description: Optional fixed container width in px. Blank = full width.

height.description: Optional fixed container height in px. Blank = auto.

body.description: Any component(s) to render inside this row item.

width.description: Percent width on desktop (0-100). Blank = auto equal split (1 item 100%, 2 items 50/50, 3 items 33.33%). Widths over 100% total wrap to the next line.

height.description: Optional fixed height in px. Blank = auto.

width_mode.description: How the item's desktop width is set. Auto / percentage uses the Width (%) field above. Fit content sizes the item to its content. Fill remaining grows the item to take the leftover space in the row. On mobile every item is full width.

align_items.description: Aligns the item's content on the cross (horizontal) axis. Requires content to leave space.

justify_content.description: Distributes the item's content on the main (vertical) axis. Needs the item to be taller than its content (e.g. a taller sibling in the row).

default_tab.description: Must match a tab value/label. Defaults to the first tab.

pattern_image.description: Optional geometric pattern shown behind the strip on mobile.

variant.description: Which social network the post is from.

url.description: Full permalink to the post/tweet, e.g. "https://twitter.com/AKU/status/123". Required.

align.description: Position of the embed within the full-width container.

show_text.description: Include the caption/text with a Facebook post embed.

bg_color.description: Rectangular photo style only — ignored by the circle collage.

description.description: Separate paragraphs with a blank line.

secondary_cta_label.description: Optional text link next to the CTA (e.g. "Explore Now").

image.description: Main photo — rectangular for the default style, circular for the circle collage.

decorative_images.description: Up to 5 photos shown as blurred circles around the main photo (circle collage only).

highlight.description: Green portion of the title (e.g. "Students Affairs").

social_links.description: Up to 4 social links (Facebook, Instagram, Spotify, Linktree).

icon.description: Optional. Overrides the default platform icon (required for Custom).

mobile_title.description: First (dark) word of the mobile "Quick Actions" heading.

mobile_title_highlight.description: Second (green) word of the mobile heading.

autoplay.description: Cycle tabs automatically (~6s), pausing on hover.

tabs.description: Each tab is one slide — pills on desktop, Quick-Action tiles on mobile.

number.description: Index shown as e.g. 01. Blank = auto from position.
